name: The Steam Laundry District
prompt: Run brass steam mains between a boiler house and residential laundries. One great wringer feeds white sheets up to rooftop drying rails above the busy street.

name: Pneumatic Post Hour
prompt: Cross a dense city block with transparent parcel tubes. A porter catches a red capsule at an open sorting booth as a neighbouring shop dispatches a blue one overhead.

name: The Lift Bridge Neighbours
prompt: Link raised workshops with small steam lift bridges. One bridge rises for a delivery crane while people queue on a brass landing beneath lines of laundry.

name: The Boiler Bath Exchange
prompt: Arrange a public bath and glasshouse beside a working steam engine. Trace warm exhaust through a copper coil into tiled pools where bathers enter under a little clock tower.

name: The Clockwork Milk Round
prompt: Give a soot-coloured neighbourhood a delivery depot of spring-driven carts. A mechanic winds one cart while another lowers milk bottles to a doorstep from a swinging rack.
